title: 2.2.1 Augmented Reality
description: Definition of AR, core hardware architecture, display equipment, and the operational overlay workflow from Grade 11 ICT Section 2.2.1.

questions.question: What is the defining concept of Augmented Reality (AR)?
options: Enhancing the real world by overlaying computer-generated digital data
Submerging users into an entirely synthetic three-dimensional universe
Converting continuous analog waves into discrete binary pulse streams
Defragmenting magnetic hard drives to consolidate scattered file blocks
questions.correctAnswer: Enhancing the real world by overlaying computer-generated digital data

questions.question: What type of user experience does Augmented Reality establish?
options: An engaging and dynamic user experience
An isolated sensory deprivation experience
A purely text-based terminal experience
A static black-and-white print experience
questions.correctAnswer: An engaging and dynamic user experience

questions.question: Which four hardware components comprise an Augmented Reality system?
options: A processor, sensors, input devices, and a display
A keyboard, mechanical mouse, monitor, and printer
A surge protector, stabilizer, transformer, and UPS
A compiler, interpreter, assembler, and debugger
questions.correctAnswer: A processor, sensors, input devices, and a display

questions.question: Why can standard mobile smartphones execute Augmented Reality apps?
options: They incorporate a processor, sensors, input, and display natively
They run on alternating current power supplied directly from walls
They operate exclusively inside virtual three-dimensional spheres
They require external force-feedback bodysuits to render screens
questions.correctAnswer: They incorporate a processor, sensors, input, and display natively

questions.question: Which display devices can be used to present augmented reality graphics?
options: Tablets, smartphones, head-mounted displays, and smart glasses
Dot matrix printers, analog oscilloscopes, and cathode ray tubes
Thermal receipt printers, monochrome pagers, and paper chart plotters
Electromechanical relays, punch card readers, and dial telephones
questions.correctAnswer: Tablets, smartphones, head-mounted displays, and smart glasses

questions.question: What two functions do display devices serve in an AR application?
options: Locating objects of focus and showing overlaid digital information
Storing relational database records and managing query results
Balancing voltage spikes and absorbing electrostatic discharge
Compiling high-level programming scripts into machine bytecodes
questions.correctAnswer: Locating objects of focus and showing overlaid digital information

questions.question: What is the initial step in the operational process of Augmented Reality?
options: Capturing a picture of the physical object through a camera
Transmitting binary packets across local area network routers
Calibrating force-feedback actuators inside sensory gloves
Defragmenting unused sectors across secondary storage drives
questions.correctAnswer: Capturing a picture of the physical object through a camera

questions.question: What image data does AR software calculate after camera capture?
options: Object measurements, surrounding items, and relative spatial distance
Operating system kernel version, CPU clock rate, and battery age
Network transmission ping latency and data encryption strength
Document print formatting margins and paper sheet orientation
questions.correctAnswer: Object measurements, surrounding items, and relative spatial distance

questions.question: What is the final step in the Augmented Reality processing pipeline?
options: Generating virtual information and overlaying it upon the real object
Disconnecting the device camera to conserve internal battery charge
Restarting the operating system to clear temporary browser caches
Backing up camera image files to an external network storage server
questions.correctAnswer: Generating virtual information and overlaying it upon the real object
